units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data Al.data

# Replicate 5x5x5
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy

thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe ke etotal press vol density

min_style cg

variable pe_per_atom equal "pe/v_natoms"

# LAMMPS input script for Aluminum surface energy calculation
# Surface normal along [0,0,1] direction

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p s

# Read structure
read_data Al.data

# Replicate 5x5x5
replicate 5 5 5

# Get box dimensions before adding vacuum
variable lx equal "lx"
variable ly equal "ly"
variable lz equal "lz"

# Add vacuum in z-direction (create surface)
change_box all z final 0.0 $(v_lz+20.0) units box

# Define potential

# Energy minimization
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe ke etotal press vol density

min_style cg
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 10000 100000

# Output final energy and area
variable natoms equal "count(all)"

print "SURFACE ENERGY: ${total_pe}"
